wontFixReason: Documented engine over-prediction at low-selectivity public schools, exposed by the 2026-05-27 closure refresh (PR #300). UCSD's prod gpaDistribution is top-heavy → a 3.82/1450 OOS profile lands above the 75th percentile and stacks gpaBand × testBand × OOS-public modifiers, returning 47.5% vs the industry-anchored [10%, 40%] band. Same root cause as the engine signal flagged by the empirical-calibration scorer (PR #299 finding: anchor × 2.5 upper clamp at low-selectivity schools). Tier B: requires gpaBand percentile lift attenuation when the school's GPA distribution is itself top-heavy. Fixture preserved to track when engine fix lands.
